title: Unpaid Rent on Safe Deposit Boxes: Late Fee, Past-Due Standing and Cure
content:
A year's rent on Safe Deposit Boxes that is unpaid within 30 calendar days after the rent due date incurs the late fee set for that size and makes the rental past due.

## Counting the grace period

Calendar days are counted with the day after the rent due date as day 1. The late fee and the past-due standing apply when the rent is still unpaid after the end of the last grace day. The rent due date is the one recorded against that rental, and it is that record, read for the rental in question, that fixes the day the count runs from.

## One fee for the year

One late fee is charged per rental year, however long the rent for that year stays unpaid. A year's rent that goes unpaid for eight months carries the same single late fee as one that goes unpaid for one month.

## While the rental is not current

While the rental stands past due or pending drilling, entry to the vault is refused. Paying everything due returns the rental to active.

## Credit of a late fee

A late fee charged contrary to this basis is credited against what is owed. A late fee is also credited as a courtesy while the lessee's count of courtesy waiver credits over the rolling 365 calendar days ending on the current date remains below the allowance of such waivers set for that size.

## The grace period at its boundary

Suppose, on hypothetical dates, that the rent due date is 1 April. The day after it, 2 April, is day 1, and the thirtieth day of grace is therefore 1 May.

| Hypothetical date on which the rent is still unpaid | Position in the count | Standing |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 30 April | day 29 | within the grace period; no late fee, and the rental remains active |
| 1 May | day 30, the last grace day | within the grace period; no late fee, and the rental remains active |
| 2 May | after the end of the last grace day | the late fee is charged and the rental becomes past due |

The boundary is exclusive of the last grace day itself: rent that is still unpaid on the thirtieth day has not yet incurred the fee, and rent paid on that day is paid within the grace period.
